features.name: Add a stock item to the catalog
List items with current stock levels
Record a stock movement (delivery in / usage out)
See items below their reorder threshold

assumptions.statement: Each item has a single reorder_threshold set at creation; the brief says "low-stock alerts" but not who configures the threshold, so it is assumed to be set per-item by whoever adds it, not a global setting.

current_stock is a derived, server-maintained field — never written directly by a client — updated only by posting a stock_movements record, so the audit trail and the live count can never drift apart.

Supplier orders are out of scope for this pass: the brief's "supplier orders" is read as a signal for WHICH items are low, not a requirement to model purchase orders/suppliers as their own entities yet.
Authentication is a bearer token; the brief specifies no auth mechanism for a presumed single-location back-office tool.

business_rules: BR-01: Every endpoint requires a valid bearer token; missing or invalid returns 401.
BR-02: A stock movement of type "out" cannot take current_stock below zero — rejected with 409, nothing is written.
BR-03: current_stock is only ever changed by creating a stock_movements record (BR-... AS-02); there is no direct PATCH on an item's stock field.
BR-04: An item name must be unique (case-insensitive) — creating a duplicate returns 409.
BR-05: The low-stock list (API-04) returns items where current_stock <= reorder_threshold, ordered most-deficient first.

collections.name: items
fields: name string required unique lowercase indexed
unit string required (e.g. kg, l, count)

collections.name: stock_movements
fields: created_at Date required default now indexed

response.items: array of {id, name, unit, current_stock, reorder_threshold}
array of items where current_stock <= reorder_threshold, most-deficient first
